description: This Java class 'BaseAssetService' implements asset management functionalities within the Thingsboard platform, including CRUD operations, asset assignment/unassignment to customers and edges, and querying assets with various filters.

classes.name: BaseAssetService
classes.description: Service class providing asset management operations such as create, update, delete, assign/unassign to customers and edges, and querying assets.

methods.name: handleEvictEvent
methods.description: Handles cache eviction events for assets.

methods.description: Retrieves AssetInfo by asset ID.

methods.description: Retrieves Asset by asset ID.

methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves Asset by asset ID.

methods.description: Asynchronously finds Asset by tenant ID and name.

methods.name: saveAsset (overload with doValidate)
methods.description: Saves or updates an Asset with optional validation.

methods.name: assignAssetToCustomer
